testcase.name: Scenario: Cancel removal of a model-state property column: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-model-browser-source/features/application/model-browser/model-browser.feature:951:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Cancel removal of a model-state property column ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the user creates model states Capture State and Copy State and activates Copy State ✔ And the user adds and accepts the Category property column in the model-state table ✔ And the user sets the active state Category to Prototype and accepts the table ✔ And an empty part with multiple model states is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And its model-state table includes a Category column ✔ And the active state's Category value is "Prototype" ✔ When the user opens the model-state table and selects Properties ✔ And the user selects Category in the chosen-property list ✔ Then the remove transfer control is enabled ✔ When the user removes the selected property from the table ✔ Then Category disappears from the chosen-property list ✔ And the Category column disappears from the member table ✔ And OK is enabled ✔ When the user cancels the table and reopens it in the same session ✔ Then the Category column is present ✔ And the active state's Category value is "Prototype" ✔ When the user cancels the table ✔ Then the same part remains active
